review.title: Keep a bookmark on the intended change

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; original PNGs opened in Firefox and inspected directly with paired JSON

Name review-* and @- revision are complete in the wrapped command; title and footer are teal and the metadata warning amber. No setup noise or clipped operands. Background row cursor remains visible while the modal is active.

video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/scenarios/refs_workspaces; original PNGs opened in Firefox and inspected directly with paired JSON
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: inspected 16 evenly spaced actual MP4 frames including first/last, all four full PNG/state pairs, ffprobe metadata and source tape. 40.2 seconds at 15fps with 80ms typing and 2–3-second teaching holds shows list, field editing, create review, target inspection, forward move, cancelled delete, confirmed delete and recreation. Captions and keyboard overlays remain below terminal content; setup/assertions are hidden. Exact-name effects and cancellation/recovery match six repository assertions.
